verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents a Google Search API that returns SERP data and a separate HTML API that scrapes one URL, optionally as markdown. Nothing in the evidence shows a single call that runs a search and returns the full page content of the results. Chaining the two APIs yourself is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search the web and get full page content from results in a single call instead of just links and snippets
